items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know when Kirstin Howell called John from my house...

ctx.x: Oh, there was an amazing amount of them, that they would sit back there and draw all kinds of -- some of them very pornographic, but nevertheless, it was art work.

I know when Kirstin Howell called John from my house, John told her to tell whoever it was that played lead trumpet in "Chorus Line" in Los Angeles, that he sure did appreciate the art work that arrived in Chicago, because the first trumpet music for "Chorus Line" was completely covered with pornographic drawings.

You know, the way some of those arrangements were marked up, every guy that would get in the band would have his own way of marking what was going on, and it's remarkable sometimes that a guy could even find out what he was supposed to do, I mean if you called a substitute in for some reason. They must have sat down and cried, because maybe this has been through a half a dozen different trumpet players, and they've all marked it differently. The same thing, but they've got a different way of marking it. It's --…
